invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is generally required for data ingestion and versioning in Hoodie, making it a likely precondition.
The method expects to insert a list of records; a null record list would likely be an error.
A valid execution context (context) is required to coordinate the engine operations.
A List in Java can be empty or have at least one element; this expresses that hoodieRecords is not null and is a legitimate collection.
